spiritgiven.comments: Helped us make calls when we didn’t have perspective

when I talk to the spirit captains we agreed with the same standard but during game we feel like the players on the team have different understanding on body contact and we have a lot of calls that cannot be solved(they need to understand that it’s really hard to avoid body contact when the opponent play small balls)
Called in bounce for us when we don’t have perspective and flipped scores when it’s wrong

Darumasan shows great attitude in communication and after the call. Although, we do think two calls should not be contested:1- the person got the disc, scored and released the disc. She said she did not jump the whole time, but still was contested. 2- the strip call, the disc is controlled before the strip.
Great communication, always open to listen, always smile. And we learned from yesterday on half time rules, the game went smoothly. Thanks for the great game!

spiritreceived.comments: Thanks for the great start to the tournament!! We really enjoyed this game!!

Rules: needed to improve in understanding of rules re body contact 
Fouls and body contact : first clarified going into the game and emphasized at half time about excessive body contact - but this was not addressed and fouls were repeatedly committed 
Positive attitude : had an incident of 1-2 individualscursing on field / towards our players 
Communication: unwillingness to listen to our perspective when discussing fouls, sidelines getting involved
They always called the fouls of violation during catching even our player's body is infront of thier body. It seems a bit unfair when they call.
There were several instances when body contact was not avoided but calls were resolved quickly.

We felt that there were some inconsistent calls with respect to travel calls, i.e. some players knew that there are no stoppages for travels, but other players seemed to think so.  

In terms of communication, it could be improved for hand signals, as there were often no proactive hand signals. We also felt we had to clarify the specific call (for eg for pick calls) as the players were not communicating effectively.
